description: This file declares interfaces and classes related to process containers, network interfaces, memory and processor info, and container management within the WPEFramework's ProcessContainers namespace. It is a header file defining abstract classes and their interfaces for managing containerized processes and resources.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: An interface for iterating over network interfaces within a container, providing methods for retrieving interface name and IP addresses.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: An interface for accessing memory usage statistics of a container, including allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: An interface for accessing CPU usage information of a container, including total and per-core usage, and number of cores.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: An iterator interface for enumerating containers, providing access to container IDs.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: An interface representing a container, providing methods to query its state, resource usage, network interfaces, and control operations like start and stop.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Static method to obtain the singleton instance of IContainerAdministrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework with specified log path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Retrieves an iterator over all existing containers.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID, returning nullptr if not found.

ctags.name: IContainerIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class IContainerIterator : public Core::IIterator, public Core::IReferenceCounted {$/

ctags.pattern: /^    class INetworkInterfaceIterator : public Core::IIterator,  public Core::IReferenceCounted  {$/
